mapper.select: SELECT pi.*,s.code sku_code FROM purchase_order_item pi JOIN sku s ON s.id=pi.sku_id WHERE pi.purchase_order_id=#{id} ORDER BY pi.id

SELECT po.id,po.po_no,po.status,po.ordered_at,po.expected_at,w.name warehouse_name, (SELECT SUM(pi.quantity) FROM purchase_order_item pi WHERE pi.purchase_order_id=po.id) ordered_qty, (SELECT SUM(pi.received_qty) FROM purchase_order_item pi WHERE pi.purchase_order_id=po.id) received_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.quantity),0) FROM stock_movement m WHERE m.reference_no=po.po_no) stocked_qty FROM purchase_order po JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=po.warehouse_id WHERE po.supplier_id=#{supplierId} ORDER BY po.ordered_at DESC,po.id DESC

SELECT po.id,po.po_no,po.status,po.ordered_at,po.expected_at,su.name supplier_name, (SELECT SUM(pi.quantity) FROM purchase_order_item pi WHERE pi.purchase_order_id=po.id) ordered_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.quantity),0) FROM stock_movement m WHERE m.reference_no=po.po_no AND m.movement_type='PURCHASE') stocked_qty FROM purchase_order po JOIN supplier su ON su.id=po.supplier_id WHERE po.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND po.ordered_at>=#{from} AND po.ordered_at<#{until} ORDER BY po.ordered_at,po.id

SELECT s.id sku_id,s.code sku_code,p.name product_name,x.units,x.revenue,x.buyers FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN (SELECT i.sku_id,SUM(i.quantity) units,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) buyers FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.status<>'CANCELLED' AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.sku_id) x ON x.sku_id=s.id WHERE p.supplier_id=#{supplierId} ORDER BY x.units DESC,s.id

SELECT s.id sku_id,s.code sku_code,p.name product_name,x.sold_60d,COALESCE(st.available_qty,0) available_qty FROM (SELECT i.sku_id,SUM(i.quantity) sold_60d FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.created_at>=DATE_SUB(#{asOf},INTERVAL 60 DAY) AND i.created_at<#{asOf} GROUP BY i.sku_id) x JOIN sku s ON s.id=x.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT sku_id,SUM(available_qty) available_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY sku_id) st ON st.sku_id=s.id WHERE p.supplier_id=#{supplierId} ORDER BY x.sold_60d DESC,s.id LIMIT 50
